completion:
Complete the following steps to accurately document failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report:

3. Identify the section on the inspection form dedicated to brake tests.
4. Note the date and time of the inspection.
5. Record the vehicle identification number (VIN), make, model, and year of the vehicle.
6. Inspect each component of the braking system, including but not limited to the brake pads, rotors, calipers, drums, shoes, brake lines, hoses, and master cylinder.
7. Conduct a comprehensive brake test, including a road test if applicable. Include additional tests such as the use of a brake meter or measuring pedal force and travel.
8. Document the specific test results and any observations, noting any irregularities, leaks, cracks, wear, or malfunctions.
9. If the vehicle fails any part of the brake test, clearly mark “Fail” in the corresponding section of the form.
